flags.problem: OUTCOME_SALES campaign (BLZ-20260717-002): $68.74 L30D spend, 0 purchases, CPM $73.76 (elevated, $50–80 range), CTR 3.11% (just above 3% = strong, creative working). 0 lifetime purchases = pixel cold. OUTCOME_SALES with no purchase signal bids into expensive conversion inventory — root causes are (a) objective mismatch and (b) possible placement mix. CTR 3.11% > 3% → Lever 4 (creative) SKIPPED.

solutions.recommendation: CPM Lever 1: Strip Stories/Reels placements — keep Facebook Feed + Instagram Feed only.
solutions.rationale: CPM $73.76. Stories/Reels CPM runs $60–120; Feed CPM runs $20–45. Placement fix is highest-impact, fastest lever (2 min). Expected CPM drop 40–60% within 24–48h.
solutions.action: Meta Ads Manager → BLZ-20260717-002 campaign → Ad Set → Edit → Placements → Manual → uncheck Stories, Reels, Search. Keep Facebook Feed + Instagram Feed only.

solutions.recommendation: CPM Lever 3: Switch to LINK_CLICKS objective when relaunching — 0 lifetime purchases means OUTCOME_SALES pixel is cold.
solutions.rationale: OUTCOME_SALES bids into purchase-intent inventory with no conversion signal. 0 purchases in 9 days of spend confirms no pixel data. LINK_CLICKS CPM runs $15–30 vs $73 current.
solutions.action: When relaunching after A-1 kill fires: duplicate → change objective to LINK_CLICKS → run to 200 clicks → relaunch as OUTCOME_SALES with warmed pixel. Budget default: $30/day for LINK_CLICKS TOF.

solutions.recommendation: Audit Shampoo post-click funnel — CTR 3.11% with 0 purchases = post-click drop confirmed.
solutions.rationale: Per L-2026-07-16-001 DOCTRINE: CTR > 2% + 0 purchases = landing page / checkout failure, not creative failure. CTR 3.11% is strong.
solutions.action: Shopify Admin → Analytics → Conversion funnel → filter 4-in-1 Shampoo. Check add-to-cart → purchase gap. If > 40% drop: enable Shop Pay default, verify $9.99 sale price shows above the fold on mobile.
